== Arrows and misc ==
← → ↑ ↓ ↔ ↕ ↖ ↗ ↘ ↙ ⇐ ⇒ ⇑ ⇓ ⇔ ⇕
• · ° ± × ÷ § ¶ © ® ™ ¡ ¿

== Zero-width characters ==
ZWJ between letters: A‍B (A + U+200D + B)
ZWNJ: fi (f + U+200C + i)
Word joiner: hello world (word + U+2060 + joiner)
BOM: ﻿start of line (U+FEFF at start)

== Tabs at various positions ==
Col1	Col2	Col3	Col4
A	BB	CCC	DDDD
Short	MediumLen	VeryLongColumnValue	X

== Lines with mixed content ==
Price: €1.234,56 (note: dot=thousands, comma=decimal in Italian)
Regex: ^(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?([a-zA-Z0-9-]+)\.([a-zA-Z]{2,})(.*)$
SQL: SELECT * FROM "users" WHERE name = 'O''Brien' AND age >= 18;
JSON: {"key": "value with \"escaped\" quotes and \\backslashes\\", "n": null}
